mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tw_h5_order ( id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT, order_no VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, user_id BIGINT NOT NULL, product_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, recommendation_id VARCHAR(64) NULL, vip_level INT NULL, title VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, amount DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', pay_channel VARCHAR(20) NULL, created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, paid_at DATETIME NULL, UNIQUE KEY uk_order_no (order_no), KEY idx_user_time (user_id, created_at) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4
mapper.select: SELECT order_no, user_id, product_type, recommendation_id, vip_level, title, amount, status, pay_channel, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS created_at, DATE_FORMAT(paid_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS paid_at FROM tw_h5_order WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} LIMIT 1

SELECT order_no, product_type, recommendation_id, vip_level, title, amount, status, pay_channel, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS created_at, DATE_FORMAT(paid_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS paid_at FROM tw_h5_order WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 50
mapper.update: UPDATE tw_h5_order SET status = 'paid', pay_channel = #{payChannel}, paid_at = NOW() WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND status = 'pending'
